Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly claimed that Anees Bazmee (director of Ready, 2011) is from Indonesia. WebSurfer’s findings indicated the film is an Indian Hindi-language film directed by Anees Bazmee, and reliable sources confirm he is an Indian director. This unverified and incorrect nationality attribution led to the wrong conclusion that the directors are from different countries, when both (Sachin Pilgaonkar and Anees Bazmee) are Indian.
